mentions.name: Unnamed Unity game
mentions.description: A Unity game in development by a two-person team, targeting a Steam release later this year. The project incorporates playtesting-at-scale tooling: telemetry from playtests is aggregated into voxel heat maps built with 3D textures and rendered in-editor, letting level designers see where thousands of samples encounter problem geometry.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am all-in on a Unity game right now. Working with one other person and hoping to ship to Steam later this year.
